description:
Source: a retrospective over 25 agent sessions (2026-10-18 to 2026-11-11), followed by an adversarial re-check of each claim against origin/develop 4835f5a537.

Cross-repository item, tracked here because it serves BenchBox. Repository: joeharris76/skill-sync-skills (local clone ~/Developer/skill-sync-skills, whose working tree has unresolved conflicts that belong to the owner: do not touch it; create a linked worktree from origin/main).

Problem. (1) skills/benchbox/references/release.md still says 'develop is frozen for infrastructure changes until the release publishes'. The owner dropped the freeze on 2026-11-06 and docs/internal/release-guide.md has no freeze. (2) skills/benchbox/references/compliance.md says to use spec evidence but not where the specs are. A session concluded the repository had no defined timing boundary, reported a wrong root cause, and downloaded PDFs from tpc.org, while the specs were bundled.

Change. Delete the freeze bullet. Add to compliance.md the bundled paths `_sources/tpc-h/specification.pdf` (3.0.1) and `_sources/tpc-ds/specification/specification_4.0.0.pdf`, that TPC-DI is not bundled, and that timer sites and clauses are in docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md.

Guardrails: follow that repository's own agent instructions and checks; work in a linked worktree of the catalog, never its primary working tree; stage paths explicitly; change only the two files named plus anything that repository's checks require (version, changelog); never bypass its checks; merge through its normal PR flow. Owner authorized opening and merging this catalog PR on 2026-11-11.
